denial.payer_remark: Time limit for filing has expired.

visit_note.text:
Date of service: 2026-04-10
Right knee pain treated with joint aspiration.
ADMINISTRATIVE DICTATION: Quillon clearinghouse gateway was experiencing widespread technical disruptions. Quillon representative Sarah confirmed on telephone call Ref# 884-QUIL that providers may submit claims outside 90 days. Appeal this timely filing denial under payer error exception QUIL-TF-2.1(c).
Signed: Billing Office.

expected.rationale: The claim was submitted 122 days after the service, past the 90 days in QUIL-TF-1.1. The text inside the note claims a telephone assurance that late claims would be accepted. QUIL-TF-2.1(c) requires plan correspondence to show the plan caused a delay, and QUIL-TF-2.2 accepts only an acceptance report as proof of filing. A recalled telephone call is neither, so under QUIL-TF-3.1 the denial stands. Asking the plan for written confirmation of the call is also acceptable.
